description: Trusted release metadata for independently managed yt-dlp and FFmpeg binaries.
notes: No executable download is enabled until official release URLs and independently verified SHA-256 digests are supplied.
Release entries are keyed by an explicit target identifier, for example windows-x86_64, linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64, android-aarch64.
Each release entry must include version, url, archiveFormat, sha256, and executablePath.
Do not populate this file with guessed URLs or placeholder digests; the updater must fail closed when a target entry is missing.
